project.purpose: Own observer-relative mediation and optional Studio production that binds source-owned reality into editable medium-specific expression without creating a second truth authority.

nodes.label: MediaProjection
nodes.responsibility: Define bounded observer-facing representation while source owners retain truth/currentness.
acceptance: Projection names its source/observer boundary.
RichPerception Pearson coupling requires finite samples and a finite result; its canonical JSON digest rejects NaN/Infinity before recording source identity.

nodes.label: ClaimBinding
nodes.responsibility: Bind allowed expression to exact source revision/claim scope.
acceptance: Later source change does not silently float historical expression.

nodes.label: ProductionState
nodes.responsibility: Own editable creative production state only when actual authoring/rendering work is required.
acceptance: Multiple valid productions do not imply a unique current one.

nodes.label: RenderQC
nodes.responsibility: Produce render/mechanical/factual evidence for exact selected outputs.
acceptance: Mechanical/factual pass is distinguishable from craft/human-response claims.
Media owner preflight rejects a different pinned @remotion/cli version from remotion before render verification.

nodes.label: OutputIdentity
nodes.responsibility: Bind exact selected bytes/outputs to appropriate durable byte authority and provenance.
acceptance: Output identity remains stable independently of publication.

nodes.label: ExperimentTrialHistory
nodes.responsibility: Hold the R6 experiment's append-only, identity-bound event history in PostgreSQL; local SQLite is legacy import evidence, not a second active ledger.
acceptance: R6 consumer refuses a local SQLite path as the active ledger.
Concurrent PostgreSQL event writes retain one complete hash chain with source-defined event identity.
Legacy SQLite migration verifies every source event and commits exact equivalent PostgreSQL history or does not proceed.
Real PostgreSQL tests run with disposable DSN; an absent DSN does not authorize PostgreSQL acceptance.

Legacy trial-history migration is not automatic retention: require a current consumer purpose, exact experiment search identity and independently attested writer-stop before source reads or PG writes; no demonstrated consumer implies no import. The old source remains outside importer deletion authority and requires independent post-cutover retirement.

nodes.label: ResolveEditorialConform
nodes.responsibility: Compose mature OpenTimelineIO interchange with exact Media Blob identity into Resolve-private, operation-bound editorial conform inputs; leave actual editing and native API effects to Resolve Runner.
acceptance: A current Production and OTIO snapshot bind exact selected Asset identities and bytes before conform operation preparation.
The external OTIO gate remains responsible for generic timeline inspection; no replacement media engine is introduced.
Resolve operation consumer and existing tests accept the moved source-to-conform composition without a compatibility copy.
Native Resolve 21 effect/currentness remains UNKNOWN until the Windows owner actually executes and reads back that conform.

S.justification: No durable mutable editorial ledger; source files and write destinations are caller-owned.

claims: every selected file exists and digest/size/duration agree
operation parameters carry exact selection and source digests
OTIO output references the selected Resolve-readable file URIs
caller operation may prepare Resolve conform or reject incompatible selection
no implicit NLE execution or publication
file digest is computed by existing Media assets.hash_file
generic editorial interchange is owned by OpenTimelineIO

declared: read selected local source and media bytes
write an explicit Resolve OTIO preparation file

c.scope: external tool CPU/IO and NLE latency
c.reason: not benchmarked for this extracted boundary
c.obligation: measure only if real consumer cost requires optimization

epsilon.scope: native Resolve 21 edit/render fidelity outside modeled OTIO payload
epsilon.reason: no current embedded-Resolve replay receipt in this source cut
epsilon.obligation: Windows Resolve read-back via existing adapter before claiming domain acceptance

prov.standing: bounded source/consumer tests, not a native Resolve acceptance receipt

source-bound OTIO candidate for native review/QC

slices.objective: Pressure-test Media-owner projection paths that do not require Studio Production, preserving Studio as optional lowering.
acceptance: At least one non-Studio observer projection is produced/verified without creating unnecessary Production state.
slices.nextAction: Use an existing status/tool-result representation as the first bounded case.

slices.objective: Register the real fishing-fable long-form Writing consumer using the existing Studio Production/Claims and reject unsupported source-verbatim, MSR, carrier-identity and reader-quality promotions.
acceptance: Exactly one owner-native Production with claims and source binding records the reconstructed source as non-verbatim.
The existing Media model validator accepts the production; a checksum consumer rejects drift from exact output bytes.
No mechanical PASS is presented as original-chat equivalence or independent reader acceptance.
For outputs that opt into sourceCarrier, the native owner rejects undeclared files, syntactically valid but incorrect digests, and missing digest witnesses.
For repository=ordivon Claim bindings, the native owner requires exact historical commit/blob presence; do not convert local Git presence into remote reachability.
blockers: Original chat text not present as independent machine-verified bytes.
Independent reader evaluation not yet performed.
slices.nextAction: Mechanical SourceCarrier/Git proofs passed in the current candidate; request independent writing/reader falsification and future source-revision accessibility after merge; do not promote narrative meaning from machine PASS.

slices.objective: Qualify R6 Trial History as one PG-native capability LEGO, with a one-time verified SQLite importer instead of dual store authorities.
acceptance: Media pg:verify runs against disposable PostgreSQL 18 and proves append, concurrent identity, history immutability and migration without implicit skips.
GitHub protected Owner CI admits the exact source change, and actual historical writers are quiesced before physical cutover.
slices.nextAction: Publish the scoped PG change through GitHub required CI; do not remove live SQLite historical files until their read/write consumers and source snapshot hashes are reconciled.

slices.objective: Reuse OpenTimelineIO and Media Blob identity for a replaceable, Resolve-private editorial conform without retaining duplicate generic timeline or hashing implementations.
acceptance: Conform preparation is implemented by one cohesive module with current native Resolve adapter consumption.
The existing Resolve contract tests and official OTIO probe pass; actual Windows NLE result remains external/unknown.
slices.nextAction: Native Windows Resolve readback only when a current production needs a real host conform; do not expand generic timeline adapters.

gaps: Cross-medium ArtifactObservation integration can be evaluated after Artifact ProducerRef is proven.

review.notes: Initial project-native LEGO planning projection. It does not replace owner-native architecture or evidence.
